title: Verify real offline Kokoro narration through VideoML
description: Companion to VideoML P16 (videoml-42506c). Explicitly prepare pinned Kokoro af_heart model and voice assets, inspect offline prerequisites, then synthesize the complete narrated fixture with credentials removed and network disabled. Record immutable model/voice revisions, dependency versions, hardware, sample counts and license provenance. No fake backend or silent fallback can satisfy this gate. Add opt-in real-model behavior documentation/tests without implicit CI downloads; any Auritus product correction must start with Gherkin and pass literal make check before a product commit. Primary owns acceptance and board writes.
